# Imported local changes

These patches document changes developed against npm-installed extension packages before their source was imported.

Their results are already incorporated into the maintained sources. The patches are retained only as provenance and are not applied during installation.

- `pi-subagents-ui.patch` → `agent/extensions/community/pi-subagents/`
- `pi-claudify-footer.patch` → `agent/extensions/community/@owlburtoe/pi-claudify/`
- `rpiv-todo-guidance.patch` → `agent/extensions/community/@juicesharp/rpiv-todo/`
